episodes.synopsis: -Long ago, the Demon King was sealed away thanks to the special magic known as Guru Guru. 300 years later, he has returned, and humanity is waiting for a hero who will rise up to oppose him. Unfortunately for them, all they'll get instead are the lazy Nike and the naive Kukuri, who set out on an adventure to save the world.
episodes.title: Departure! Boering Village!

episodes.synopsis: The northern town of North is plagued by misfortune now that monsters have moved into nearby Saw Mountain. Our heroes are unsure about whether they can help liberate the town, but when a monster kidnaps Kukuri and a local girl, Nike doesn't have much of a choice but to take action.
episodes.title: Dance! North Town!

episodes.synopsis: What are the secrets of Guru Guru? Even Kukuri, the last known inheritor of the magic techniques, doesn't know for sure. It's just then when a mysterious woman appears who may have some answers.
episodes.title: Battle! On Saw Mountain!

episodes.synopsis: Nike and Kukuri meet with a mysterious society, and that meeting sends them on a quest to gain the strength to beat the Demon King.
episodes.title: Off to the Training House!

episodes.synopsis: While Kukuri's Guru Guru training proceeds, Nike has to team up with the priestess Juju to save the village of Dohgma.
episodes.title: Rescue! Dohgma Village!

episodes.synopsis: With their training complete, Nike and Kukuri continue their journey only to run into a fearsome new rival.
episodes.title: A Rival Appears! Yondor Village!

episodes.synopsis: The quest continues as Nike and Kukuri arrive in a fairy village, where the elder offers to share new Guru Guru secrets in exchange for the defeat of a nearby monster.
episodes.title: Discovery! The Fairy Forest!

episodes.synopsis: Nike and Kukuri are reunited with an old friend, and head to Cattongue Valley in pursuit of the daemon, Siren.
episodes.title: Reunion! Cattongue Valley!

episodes.synopsis: Kukuri and her party arrive in mysterious ruins with a mysterious connection to her past, and before heading to Endless Tower.
episodes.title: Mystery! Ruins of the Migu Migu Clan!

episodes.synopsis: At the top of Endless Tower, Nike, Kukuri, and Toma confront one of the Demon King's enforcers in a battle to reach Siren.
episodes.title: Clearing the Endless Tower!

episodes.synopsis: Captured by a group of thieves in the kingdom of Copahl, Kukuri and her hero get wrapped up in a plot involving an evil chancellor and a magic artifact.
episodes.title: Apprenticeship! Copa's Forest!

episodes.synopsis: Joined by Runrun, Juju, and Sly the thief, our heroes enter Copahl Castle in an attempt to rescue its princess and retrieve the Banana Moon, a powerful magic relic.
episodes.title: Fight! Copahl Castle!

episodes.synopsis: Having saved the kingdom of Copahl, Nike and Kukuri find themselves headed towards a strange land inhabited by monsters. But are they friend or foe?
episodes.title: Legends! Tellum Village!

episodes.synopsis: Nike and Kukuri find a hint that might lead them to the next daemon, but Giri's forces are intent on sabotaging their relationship before that happens.
episodes.title: Enigmatic! Alahabica!

episodes.synopsis: With Kukuri having been turned into a demon it's up to Nike and Toma to find a way to turn her back to normal, while also tracking down the location of the daemon hidden near Alahabica.
episodes.title: Love! In the Uncanny Lands!

episodes.synopsis: The hidden ruins of Panfos have appeared, but the Demon King's army is planning an assault. Can Nike and his friends defend the tower and find Kukuri, who has gone missing inside of it?
episodes.title: Defense! The Panfos Ruins!

episodes.synopsis: Nike and Kukuri tread through a scorching desert and make their way to Erueru village, where they learn of a ritual that may help the hero unlock his next level of magic.
episodes.title: Beat It! Erueru Village!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Land of Flowers, Nike and Kukuri arrive at Ettle Village, a town known for it's chocolate. After finding out that monsters are keeping the confectionery business shut down, they head into the woods in pursuit of satisfying Kukuri's sweet tooth.
episodes.title: Bloom! The Land of Flowers!

episodes.synopsis: With Kukuri kidnapped by Raid and the Queen of Flowers under assault, can Nike rescue his traveling companion and protect their surrogate daughter?
episodes.title: Sing! The Tower of Batoha!

episodes.synopsis: Nike and Kukuri have been on Lef Island for a while now, and while their time there is pleasant, they find themselves having a hard time moving on. Are they just enjoying the island's leisurely place, or is there something stranger going on?
episodes.title: Escape! Lef Island!

episodes.synopsis: While Nike and Kukuri were trapped on Lef Island, the Demon King was revived! With the demonic threat looming larger than ever, they hurry to the Jitari Ruins to obtain the next tool in their quest.
episodes.title: Revived! Demon King Giri!

episodes.synopsis: An ancient secret rests within the Jitari Ruins, and the Demon King's forces have kidnapped Juju to unleash it. WIll Nike, Kukuri, and Toma arrive in time to save their friend?
episodes.title: Sneaking in! The Jitari Ruins!

episodes.synopsis: After all their struggles, Nike, Kukuri, and their friends have arrived in the Demon King's territory: the continent of Zan. But before they can confront the master of evil, old rivals will stand in their way.
episodes.title: Battle! Giri's Castle!

episodes.synopsis: It's all come down to this moment... the hero Nike must defend companion, the Guru Guru user Kukuri, as she attempts to seal away Demon King Giri. With the fate of the world in the balance, can they overcome the overwhelming dark powers of an entity that threatens to overwrite all of reality? And even if they do win, what will become of them?
episodes.title: Engaged! A Heart in Love!
